description: This file defines classes and methods for collecting JavaScript and CSS coverage data in Chromium via the DevTools Protocol, including starting/stopping coverage, handling script and stylesheet parsing, and managing event listeners.

classes.name: CRCoverage
classes.description: Main class managing JavaScript and CSS coverage collection.

classes.name: JSCoverage
classes.description: Handles JavaScript code coverage collection, including script parsing and coverage data aggregation.

classes.name: CSSCoverage
classes.description: Handles CSS stylesheet coverage collection, including stylesheet parsing and coverage data aggregation.

methods.name: startJSCoverage
methods.description: Starts JavaScript coverage collection with specified options.

methods.name: stopJSCoverage
methods.description: Stops JavaScript coverage collection and returns coverage data.

methods.name: startCSSCoverage
methods.description: Starts CSS coverage collection with specified options.

methods.name: stopCSSCoverage
methods.description: Stops CSS coverage collection and returns coverage data.

methods.name: _onScriptParsed
methods.description: Handles the event when a script is parsed, storing its source if applicable.

methods.name: _onExecutionContextsCleared
methods.description: Handles execution context clearing, resetting script data if configured.

methods.name: _onStyleSheet
methods.description: Handles stylesheet addition, storing stylesheet source if applicable.
